messages.en: I've sent you the recording of our class from earlier, okay?
Thanks! I just want to listen to the last part again.

senses.en_definition: A friend or companion, especially someone one studies, works, or plays with.
A colleague, associate, or partner in an organization, venture, or activity.

messages.en: I'm at the café now. Where are you sitting?
At the table by the window. I'm with an old school friend. Come over, I'll introduce you.

senses.en_definition: An enormous, typically humanlike creature in stories; a giant or monster.
Extremely large in size, scale, power, or degree; gigantic.

messages.en: Have you seen that movie? The monster's insanely huge! The building next to it looks tiny!
Yeah! When it appeared behind that building, I thought it was a hill at first. Turns out it was its head!

senses.en_definition: The people of a country collectively; in some contexts, an individual citizen.
The subjects or followers under the authority of a ruler or chief.
Ordinary people, as distinct from royalty or the nobility.
An army or body of troops, especially in traditional narratives.

messages.en: I only bought a few things earlier, and it already came to nearly a hundred ringgit.
Exactly, prices just keep going up. Ordinary people like us really have to watch our spending.
Let's just cook at home this week. That'll save us a bit on food.
